title: Body-extractor rejections (malformed JSON, wrong field types, missing content-type) return axum's plain-text body, not JSON
evidence: src/lib.rs:180,257 use bare `Json(input): Json<BookInput>`; axum returns 400 (syntax) / 422 (e.g. year:"abc") / 415 (no content-type) with a text/plain body, bypassing ApiError's {"error":...} shape. tests/api.rs:128 asserts only the status, not the body.
suggestion: Accept `Result<Json<BookInput>, JsonRejection>` and map the rejection into ApiError::bad_request so every error response is JSON.

title: year restricted to 1000..=2100, rejecting legitimate older works
evidence: src/lib.rs:72-76 returns 400 for any year outside 1000..=2100; the spec only requires title/author validation.
suggestion: Drop the lower bound or document it as a deliberate constraint (README.md does document it).
